sentences.text: [slightly surprised] This emperor of China ended up watering plants.
He was crowned emperor at two years old.
Servants dressed him, fed him, even carried him.
Then he lost the throne, and spent ten years in a prison camp.
That's where he learned to tie his own shoes. [pause] He was forty-four.
When he got out, his new boss handed him a watering can.
[deadpan, dry humor] He peaked at age two.
